title: Prospective DEV test on NIST mds2-2997 sky130 transistors at 4 K (MPW-5 tile): the I7-1 frozen S1_lodo rule and the I3-2 bias-only correction
status: IN FORCE from the commit that adds this version (2026-10-20). Written before any card fit on these data, before any correction was trained and before any S statistic was computed. Done before this version: download and sha256 check (data/sources.json), parsing and inventory of every MPW-5 transistor file and every ETest file (inventory.json; checks read every current array, before the split), the Vb = 0 dataset of the two families (data/manifest.json), the DEV / TEST split (split.json; geometry, flags and bin coverage only), and a stock-card smoke on 4 DEV devices (smoke/smoke.json; shape, finiteness, sign and timing; no RRMS, no fit). Smoke runs of the start / stats / s3 / lodo / baselines / decide modes are run after this commit with reduced settings into smoke_* directories, check the code only and are not used for any decision. The draft open questions were closed by the coordinator's decisions (section decisions)

questions.P_a: does the I7-1 frozen rule, applied to S1_lodo computed from the DEV training folds, predict the sign of ln GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) on this new measured dataset?
questions.P_b: does the I3-2 bias-only correction M_bias lower held-out error relative to C0_refit on this dataset (the I3-2 claim on new measured data)?
questions.P_c: secondary: does sign(S3_D) predict the sign of ln GMR(M_bias, C0_refit)?

parents.I7_1_frozen_rule: out/research/explore/I7_1/prereg_amendment_2026-10-20.json frozen_rule: predicted y_D = 0.007619219249052826 - 0.4851839492908733 * S1_lodo_D; predicted gain iff S1_lodo_D > 0.015703774331753538 (fitted on 11 stored datasets; 16/20 sign correct on 20 simulated prospective datasets, out/research/explore/I7_1/decision.json)

data.source: NIST mds2-2997, 'CMOS Sky130 Primitives measured at cryogenic temperatures' (doi:10.18434/mds2-2997; record version 1.1.2), NIST public data statement. File 'MPW-5 Test Tile.zip' (39,471,626 bytes, sha256 3a2cd00d40a059ade77b36afbeb45bc819e77ca80858668226809e3e932a03e3, equal to the NIST metadata value); 'ETest Tile.zip' (3,807,177 bytes, sha256 b1c8374056cf9288d5e2ea2b63f50d22a3956fbc46f9dee3c89088b75e7c1383, equal) is inventoried and not used. Local copies under out/research/data_raw/nist_mds2_2997/ (gitignored). Read as text (MDM) and as XML inside the xlsx ZIP by cryoml.explore.i8_1_nist under python -I; nothing from the download is executed
data.measurement: MPW-5 test tile (November 2023), Lakeshore closed-cycle probe station, chuck temperature 4 K, Agilent 4156B (tile README); no temperature field in the MDM headers. Source grounded; drain SMU compliance 0.1 A, gate SMU 1 mA
data.families: nfet_01v8_lvt (folder nthin_lvt, modules 20-26) and pfet_01v8_lvt (pthin_lvt, modules 27-31): the device types of the two 77 K paper cards (spice_pdk._SUBCKT). W/L from 'Module Layout Coding.xlsx' sheet FETModules (global module = local column number + the 'Column # +N' offset)
data.devices: nfet_01v8_lvt 56 (56 W/L, W 0.42-7 um, L 0.15-8 um); pfet_01v8_lvt 40 (40 W/L, W 0.42-7 um, L 0.35-20 um). One device per W/L. Excluded: nfet_01v8_lvt_W1p65_L0p25_m23p4 (folder readme '23_4 Issue'; Id-Vd gate-control ratio 12.1 < 100)
data.curves: Vb = 0 curves only, 9 per device: Id-Vg at |Vd| 0.1 and 1.8 V (keys idvg@d0, idvg@d1; |Vg| 0-1.8 V, 10 mV, 181 points) and Id-Vd at |Vg| 0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8 V (keys idvd@g0..g6; |Vd| 0-1.8 V, 20 mV, 91 points). The body-bias curves (Id-Vg at 4 further Vb, Id-Vd at Vb -1 / +1 V) are not used. Pipeline convention (to_pipeline_curves): signed voltages, pMOS Id as a positive magnitude, as the 77 K curves
data.inclusion_rule: measured-only (decision D4): clean_current, trim to the first |I| > 1e-10 A, denominator = trimmed mean |I|, include iff > 3e-7 A (Id-Vd) or > 2e-7 A (Id-Vg), both polarities; stored on the starting-card records. DEV: 198 included curves for 33 nMOS devices (6 each), 102 for 24 pMOS devices (2-6 each)

split.rule: strata = family x 77 K card bin coverage; per stratum devices sorted by (L, W), consecutive blocks of 5, seeded permutation puts 3 of 5 in DEV (short last block round(0.6 n)); numpy.random.default_rng(20261021) (cryoml.explore.i8_1_nist.make_split)
split.counts: DEV 57 (nfet_01v8_lvt 33: 12 bin-covered, 21 not; pfet_01v8_lvt 24: 13 covered, 11 not); TEST 38 (nMOS 22: 8 / 14; pMOS 16: 9 / 7); excluded 1
split.TEST_policy: no mode after the split loads TEST arrays (dev_devices loads DEV tags only); no TEST curve has been simulated; TEST is used once in the December TEST run with the method frozen at that time

compact_model.cards: the 77 K paper cards of the canonical setup: nMOS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt__tt_77k.corner.spice (original published card), pMOS update_sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt__tt_77k.corner.spice (upstream 39b1e51), as built by spice_pdk.ensure_pdk77k (data/processed/pdk77k/); tnom = -196.15 C in every bin
compact_model.bin_coverage: the 77 K cards hold only the bins of the 18 paper devices (nMOS 8 bins, pMOS 12). Geometries inside a bin: nfet_01v8_lvt 21 of 56, pfet_01v8_lvt 22 of 40 (DEV 12 of 33 and 13 of 24 = 25 of 57)
compact_model.simulator: ngspice-41 native arm64 build (/Users/anrunw/cryo-ng41/arm64/bin/ngspice), the canonical 77 K library (spice_pdk.ensure_pdk77k) with the device's corner file patched (forced bin, fitted parameter values written into that bin, spice_pdk._patch_params_in_bin); deck as spice_pdk._batch_deck (.options scale=1.0, temp=-196.15, alter / dc / wrdata per curve on the measured grid, -i(VD), pMOS negated) with the instance line Xm1 nd ng 0 0 <subckt> l w nf=1 ad=as=0.29 W p, pd=ps=2 (W + 0.29) u, nrd=nrs=0.29 / W, sa=sb=sd=0, mult=1, m=1 for every device (cryoml.explore.i8_1_nist.simulate; the spice_pdk per-paper-device mult and minimal-instance tables are not applied). One ngspice process per device and card with all 9 sweeps; timeout 60 s
compact_model.bin_rule: decision D2: every instance references one bin explicitly (spice_pdk._force_bin): covered geometries the natively selected bin (find_bin_index), uncovered geometries the bin whose (ln L, ln W) box is nearest (Euclidean distance, 0 inside; largest DEV distance 1.09). Stretch factors per device: s_L = exp(max(ln(Lmin/L), 0, ln(L/Lmax))), s_W likewise, reported in start/bins.json. Check (stock smoke): forcing the native bin reproduces native selection exactly
compact_model.deck_temperature: 77 K (decision D3, with the limitation stated there)

cards.parameter_set: the 43-parameter sky130 set of I3-2 (out/cold_loop/full_direct/round_3/spec.json selected_parameters)
cards.stock: the 77 K card in the device's bin with the 43 parameters written as their showmod readback values (6 significant digits); the stock smoke reports the difference to the unpatched card
cards.starting_cards: per DEV device: ngspice_fit.polish from the stock values, max_nfev 3000 (total NGSpice runs), irls_rounds 3, diff_step 0.01, objective = mean included-curve RRMS (frozen measured inclusion); best card seen kept (I5-1 / I6-1 recipe)
cards.training_records: one NGSpice simulation of each DEV device's starting card on its measured grid (e1_correction.DeviceRec, source 'nist4k', family nmos / pmos, vdd 1.8, curve keys idvg@d0..d1, idvd@g0..g6)
cards.box: cold_start round-one widths (sky130 rule) around the stock value v of the device's bin: VTH0 v x/÷ 3, U0, NFACTOR, VSAT, DELTA, RDSW, ETA0 v x/÷ 100, the other 36 parameters v x/÷ 3, log-scaled with the sign kept; parameters with v = 0 inactive (cold_start.spec_from_centers rule). v = showmod readback of the bin at 77 K (cryoml.explore.i8_1_nist.base_box)

arms.C0: the starting card of the held-out device, scored without refit (reported; not in P_a or P_b)
arms.C0_refit: control: held-out card refit without correction from its starting card, ngspice_fit.polish max_nfev 400, irls_rounds 2, diff_step 0.01 (I3-2 settings)
arms.M_bias: PRIMARY: I3-2 recipe unchanged: I = I_card * exp(g), g = tanh(MLP 3-16-16-1 of (is_pmos, |Vgs|/VDD, |Vds|/VDD)), VDD = 1.8 V, inputs standardized on the fold training points, loss = mean paper RRMS of the corrected training records + 1e-4 L2, Adam 3e-3, 2000 full-batch steps, float64, seeds 0-4, g = mean of the 5 members (i3_2_bias.fit_bias); trained on the fold's training records, frozen; held-out card refit with g in the loop (same settings as C0_refit); best card re-simulated, multiplied by exp(g), scored
arms.T1_inloop: non-deployable comparator: one log-gain per (polarity, curve key) (e1_correction.fit_arm('T1')) on the fold's training records; held-out refit with it in the loop. Curve keys index the same bias within a polarity (bias grid identical across devices of one family)

baselines_reported.B1: wider BSIM4 set, no correction: base box plus extras fitted jointly from the starting card. Universe: the 115-name sky130 sensitivity universe (out/pdk_parameter_sensitivity/summary.json) minus the 43 base names, values from the showmod readback of the device's bin (names not reported skipped); I4-1 box rule (b1_param_box: nonzero v -> |v|/2 .. 2|v| log; zero v -> BSIM4_ZERO_RANGE if listed, else inactive); screen (job I8_1_baselines, before the refits): a name is kept if its edge response >= 1e-4 on at least one DEV starting card (i4_1_baselines.edge_response); max_nfev from i4_1_baselines.matched_nfev
baselines_reported.B2: I4-1 B2: equal extrinsic series resistors per side outside the card (netlist), rext in [0, 4 x 0.5 x RDSW_start / W_um] ohm (start 0), heating factor exp(kappa |Vds I| / P_max), kappa in [-0.5, 0.5] (start 0); fitted jointly with the base box; matched max_nfev
baselines_reported.B3_d3: I4-1 B3_d3: shared polynomial correction of total degree 3 in the standardized (|Vgs|/VDD, |Vds|/VDD), per polarity, g = tanh(P), trained on the fold's training records (i4_1_baselines.fit_poly); held-out refit with it in the loop
baselines_reported.role: reported with GMR(M_bias, X) and GMR(X, C0_refit) and device-bootstrap CIs; not in P_a, P_b or the validity conditions

evaluation.folds: leave-one-device-out over the 57 DEV devices (one device per geometry); training pool for M_bias, T1 and B3_d3 = the other 56 DEV devices, both polarities, one network (is_pmos input), as I3-2
evaluation.metric: strict paper RRMS with the frozen measured inclusion (e1_correction.score_device, non-sky130 branch): per included curve RMSE over the trimmed points / trimmed mean |I_measured|, device value = mean over included curves; a non-finite included curve makes the device NaN (failed). Every scored current is a fresh NGSpice simulation of the refit card, multiplied by exp(g) for M_bias and T1
evaluation.aggregates: all-device mean over DEV, combined = mean of the nMOS and pMOS family means, median, per-device values, failed count; per family; on the 25 bin-covered devices (decision D2 secondary)
evaluation.decision_statistic: GMR(A, B) = exp(mean_i ln(rrms_A_i / rrms_B_i)) over devices with both values finite and > 0; device bootstrap 95% CI = 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles over 10000 resamples (numpy default_rng(0)); wins = devices with rrms_A < rrms_B (i3_2_bias.paired_ratio). y_D = ln GMR(M_bias, C0_refit)

statistics_before_outcome.S1_lodo: I7-1 definition unchanged (out/research/explore/I7_1/prereg.json definitions; i7_1_transfer.stats_for): computed per fold from the starting-card records of the fold's 56 training devices only (no held-out record, no refit card, no outcome); 12 x 12 bins of (|Vgs|/VDD, |Vds|/VDD) per polarity, residual clip +-1, M_bias loss weights. Dataset value S1_lodo_D = mean over the 57 folds (fold mean weighted by held-out devices; 1 per fold). Also S1_pooled and S2 (reported)
statistics_before_outcome.S3: I7-1 definition unchanged: for fold f (held-out device f, training set D_f = DEV minus f) and each inner device h of D_f, M_bias reduced recipe (seed 0, 500 steps) trained on DEV minus {f, h}, applied post hoc (no refit) to h's starting-card record: v(f, h) = ln(RRMS_corrected / RRMS_start); S3_f = mean over h; S3_D = mean over folds. The training set DEV minus {f, h} is the same for (f, h) and (h, f); one fit per unordered pair (1596 fits) serves both (deterministic seed, identical result)
statistics_before_outcome.prediction_file: out/research/explore/I8_1/prediction.json: S1_lodo_D, S1_pooled_D, S2_D, S3_D, per-fold values, predicted y_D (frozen rule), predicted sign for P_a and P_c, per-family secondary predictions, G and G1 choices, git HEAD at the stats run, and the sha256 of the starting-card record files
statistics_before_outcome.per_family_secondary: nMOS-only (resp. pMOS-only) dataset: S1_lodo_fam = mean over the family's folds of S1_lodo computed on the fold's same-family training records; S3_fam = mean over the family's folds of the mean of v(f, h) over same-family h; y_fam = mean over the family's held-out devices of ln(M_bias / C0_refit) from the primary run; predicted signs as P_a (frozen rule) and P_c
statistics_before_outcome.gates: G: M_bias for every DEV device if S3_D < 0, else C0_refit; G1: M_bias if 0.007619219249052826 - 0.4851839492908733 S1_lodo_D < 0, else C0_refit. Outcome: ln GMR(G, C0_refit) = y_D if G chooses M_bias, else 0; ln GMR(G, M_bias) = ln GMR(G, C0_refit) - y_D (I8-2 definitions)

order_of_operations: 1. Commit this file alone and push (pre-registration commit). Then commit the code and the smoke runs (smoke_* directories, reduced settings, not used for any decision).
2. Queue job I8_1_start: starting cards of the 57 DEV devices; start/bins.json (bin, stretch factors), start/records (DeviceRec files with the frozen inclusion), start/summary.json.
3. Queue job I8_1_stats: S1_lodo, S1_pooled, S2, S3 (and per-family values) from start/records only; writes prediction.json. Reads no refit card and no held-out score.
4. Queue job I8_1_commit_prediction: commits prediction.json alone and pushes; fails if the file is missing.

5. Queue job I8_1_lodo: C0, C0_refit, M_bias, T1_inloop. Refuses to start unless prediction.json is tracked by git, unmodified in the working tree, and contained in a commit that is an ancestor of HEAD; records that commit hash in results.json.
6. Queue job I8_1_baselines: B1 screen, then B1, B2, B3_d3 on the same folds (same guard).
7. Queue job I8_1_decide: P_a, P_b, P_c, secondary outcomes, validity; decision.json. Recomputes S1_lodo_D from start/records and checks it against prediction.json (|difference| < 1e-12).

P_a.outcome: 'correct' if sign(y_D) equals the predicted sign, else 'wrong'. Also reported: |y_D - predicted y_D| and whether y_D lies within the frozen rule's in-sample residual RMS (I7-1 step 2) of the prediction (not deciding). One dataset gives one binary outcome; the per-family values (nMOS-only and pMOS-only S1_lodo_D and y_D) are reported, not deciding

P_b.R1: the upper bound of the device-bootstrap 95% CI of GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) over the DEV devices is < 1
P_b.R2: M_bias all-device mean <= T1_inloop all-device mean + 0.005

outcomes.gain, inconclusive: R1 holds, R2 or R3 fails
outcomes.not supported: the CI of GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) contains 1
outcomes.harm: the lower bound of the CI is > 1

criterion.P_c: secondary: predicted gain iff S3_D < 0; outcome 'correct' / 'wrong' as P_a; no frozen magnitude rule

validity.V1: starting fits: >= 90% of DEV devices have a finite starting-card RRMS and >= 2 included curves; otherwise the run is invalid and no P_a / P_b outcome is stated
validity.V2: C0_refit and M_bias each have <= 10% failed devices and >= 45 paired devices; otherwise invalid
validity.V3: prediction.json was committed (order step 4) before any lodo output existed; the commit hash recorded in results.json is an ancestor of the results commit; otherwise P_a and P_c are reported as 'not prospective' and not counted
validity.V4: 0 ngspice processes stopped by the timeout in the start and lodo jobs, or the count is reported and devices with a timeout in any arm are dropped from every arm

criterion.implementation: scripts/research/explore/i8_1_nist.py modes start, stats, commit_prediction, lodo, baselines, decide (functions in cryoml.explore.i8_1_nist)

secondary.covered_subset: decision D2: P_b statistics on the 25 bin-covered DEV devices (reported, not deciding)
secondary.per_family: nMOS-only and pMOS-only: sign(y_fam) vs the frozen-rule sign on S1_lodo_fam and vs sign(S3_fam)
secondary.gates: G and G1: GMR(G, C0_refit), GMR(G, M_bias), and whether the gate chose the arm with the lower GMR

secondary_reported_not_deciding: C0 (starting card) and stock-card RRMS per device
GMR and CI per family and per bin-coverage stratum (covered vs forced nearest bin)
fold-level Spearman(S1_lodo_f, y_f) (I7-1 found it reversed within datasets)

compute.smoke_timing: stock 77 K card, 9 sweeps (2 x 181 + 7 x 91 points) in one ngspice-41 process: 0.023-0.025 s per simulation (0.04-0.09 s for the first call of a process, which includes the native-bin lookup); same at deck temperature 77 K and 4.2 K; 0 non-finite curves
compute.estimate: ngspice_fit.polish max_nfev counts NGSpice runs: starting fits 57 x 3000 runs x about 0.03 s = about 1.4 CPU-h; S1 statistics about 10 s; S3 1596 fits of 1 seed x 500 steps on about 56 x 5 curves (2-4 s each) = 1-2 CPU-h; LODO 57 x 3 refits x 400 runs x about 0.03 s = about 0.6 CPU-h plus 57 x 5 M_bias seeds x 2000 steps (about 10-20 s each) = 0.8-1.6 CPU-h; baselines about 1 CPU-h. Total about 5-7 CPU-h, about 60-80 min wall on 6 workers. Refined after the smoke
compute.jobs: I8_1_start, I8_1_stats, I8_1_s3, (prediction commit), I8_1_lodo, I8_1_decide; process pool of 6 workers, 1 torch thread each; one compute-heavy job at a time (CLAUDE.md resource policy). Not queued

data_reuse_note: These data have not been used by any earlier direction (the I3-1 and 2026-10-20 catalog passes read the tile README, the layout xlsx and three MDM files). Before this file: inventory checks over all files, the split, and the 4-device stock-card smoke (no RRMS). DEV results will be development evidence for the I3-2 claim and prospective evidence for the I7-1 rule (P_a) only if V3 holds
frozen_choices_note: All choices above are fixed by this commit. No DEV result is used to change them; a later variant gets a new id or a dated amendment that leaves this file unchanged

D1_families.reason: these are the device types of the two 77 K paper cards (spice_pdk._SUBCKT); nfet_01v8 has no 77 K card

D2_bins.decision: PRIMARY: all 57 DEV devices; every instance references one bin explicitly: the bin ngspice selects natively (spice_pdk.find_bin_index) for the 25 bin-covered geometries, the nearest bin for the 32 others. PRE-REGISTERED SECONDARY: the same statistics (GMR, CI, wins, means) restricted to the 25 bin-covered DEV devices, computed from the same per-device results (no separate run). The bin stretch factor is reported per device
D2_bins.reason: the pruned 77 K cards hold only the 18 paper-device bins; the covered subset alone (25 devices) gives a wide bootstrap CI; the secondary subset shows whether the forced bins change the result

D3_deck_temperature.decision: deck .options temp = -196.15 C (77 K), the card's tnom
D3_deck_temperature.reason: avoids extrapolating the BSIM4 temperature equations from 77 K to 4 K; the card refit absorbs the difference. LIMITATION: the simulated device is a 77 K device whose parameters are fitted to 4 K data; kT/q, the band gap and the intrinsic carrier density in the model stay at their 77 K values, so the 4 K subthreshold slope is reproduced only through the fitted parameters (e.g. NFACTOR, VOFF, CIT)

D4_inclusion.decision: measured-only rule as in I5-1 / I6-1 (pdk2.metric: clean, trim to the first |I| > 1e-10 A, include iff trimmed mean |I| > 3e-7 A Id-Vd / 2e-7 A Id-Vg, both polarities), evaluated and stored on the C0 starting-card records (start job) and used unchanged by every arm
D4_inclusion.reason: the rule depends on the measured current only, so no fit can change which curves count; the rrmsCalc pMOS rule has no trim-floor entry for these geometries and would include near-zero measured curves where the card conducts

D5_curve_set.reason: the deck ties the body to ground; same setting as the I7-1 calibration datasets

D6_box.decision: cold_start round-one widths (sky130 rule) around the stock value v of the device's bin: VTH0 v x/÷ 3, U0, NFACTOR, VSAT, DELTA, RDSW, ETA0 v x/÷ 100, the other 36 parameters v x/÷ 3, log-scaled with the sign kept; parameters with v = 0 inactive (cold_start.spec_from_centers rule). v = showmod readback of the bin at 77 K
D6_box.reason: the sky130 rule used for the 43-parameter sky130 fits; the centre is the stock 77 K card, the starting point of every fit here

D7_S1_records.decision: frozen I7-1 definition: starting-card records of the fold's training devices
D7_S1_records.reason: the frozen rule was calibrated on that definition; C0_refit cards exist only for held-out devices

D8_baselines.decision: B1, B2, B3_d3 (I4-1 recipes) in a separate job on the same folds; reported, not in the decision rule
D8_baselines.reason: context for the size of any M_bias gain at the cost of about 1 CPU-h

D9_vdd.decision: VDD = 1.8 V for the M_bias / T1 / B3 inputs
D9_vdd.reason: largest |V| of every MPW-5 sweep, so |V|/VDD <= 1

D10_P_a.decision: P_a stays the dataset-level binary sign prediction; prediction.json also registers the predicted y_D of the frozen rule, and per-family secondary predictions (nMOS-only and pMOS-only: S1_lodo, S3, predicted signs) as secondary outcomes
D10_P_a.reason: one dataset gives one binary outcome; the magnitude and per-family values add information without changing the primary

D11_gates.decision: I8-2 gates G (M_bias iff S3_D < 0, else C0_refit) and G1 (M_bias iff the frozen rule predicts a gain) registered as secondary predictions in prediction.json
D11_gates.reason: no extra compute; prospective check of the I8-2 gates

draft_open_questions_closed.Q1_nmos_family: the nMOS 77 K paper card is nfet_01v8_lvt (spice_pdk._SUBCKT, upstream README), not nfet_01v8. This draft uses nthin_lvt (56 devices). nthin (nfet_01v8, 80 devices, W 0.36-7, L 0.15-20) has no 77 K card in the repository; using it needs the room-temperature sky130 nfet_01v8 card (Volare) as the starting card
draft_open_questions_closed.Q2_bin_coverage: 21 of 56 nMOS and 22 of 40 pMOS geometries lie in a bin of the pruned 77 K cards. Options: (a) covered geometries only (DEV 25: 12 nMOS + 13 pMOS); (b) all DEV devices with the forced nearest bin for the 32 uncovered (draft); (c) the full room-temperature sky130 lvt cards (all bins) as stock. With (a) the bootstrap CI rests on 25 devices
draft_open_questions_closed.Q3_deck_temperature: 77 K deck temperature (draft; card at its tnom) or 4.2 K (card temperature model extrapolated; smoke: at 4.2 K the simulated subthreshold currents of the stock card drop to the 1.8e-12 A GMIN floor for |Vg| <= 0.6 V (nMOS) / 0.9 V (pMOS), on-currents at |Vg| = |Vd| = 1.8 V change by < 3%; values at |Vd| = 1.8 V). I6-1 used the stage temperature with the temperature coefficients set to 0
draft_open_questions_closed.Q4_inclusion: draft: measured-only rule (pdk2.metric; trim floor 1e-10 A and nMOS thresholds for both polarities, as I5-1 / I6-1). The rrmsCalc pMOS rule (inclusion by |I_sim| at the last trimmed point, frozen from the C0 starting card; per-geometry trim floors) has no floor entry for the MPW-5 geometries and includes near-zero measured curves (Id-Vd at |Vg| 0.3-0.6 V) whenever the card conducts there.
